## About me

I am Hermogenes David Rios. I'm from Bolivia and currently studying Economics and Statistics at Macalester College in Saint Paul, Minnesota.

My work sits at the intersection of data, policy, and inequality. I am particularly interested in macroeconomic modeling, labor markets, migration, and applied econometrics. Learn more [about me](about.qmd):
